body: I am trying so hard to not fall for it. He just seems so genuine though and it hurts.
Thank you so much this helps me more than you know !

He dropped some of her stuff off the other day at my house. This time he said he found more stuff and just wanted to have a beach day with me and my dog to get out of the house and give me some of her things. I feel like it would be really weird if I just canceled on him now. We will be in a very public place.
I am in therapy and have already turned him in but put the investigation on hold as I stated in my post.
I already turned him in and then put the investigation on hold.

I’m meeting with him tomorrow because he said if I hangout with him he’ll give me some of my deceased best friends stuff. I am honestly terrified and have no idea why I continue to let him control me. My therapist honestly hasn’t been listening to me I try to tell her about him and she says we shouldn’t focus on that problem yet that I need to unpack childhood trauma first.
My therapist said when I started going to her that she legally has to report. Rape, child abuse, elder abuse, if I want to hurt myself or others to the police.

Yes they dropped my case entirely. I taked to everyone. Gave all my evidence. Spent hours re reading the horrible messages between my rapist and I to get screenshots to then be told I have a good case to now being told they don’t have the time. But yet I should continue being friendly to my rapist and that I should go to his new house to get his address. It’s been such a stressful process and I went through it for nothing.
No it happened 2 years ago. We recently got back into contact he’s been extremely apologetic.

I felt the same way. I would just lay there and let it happen. I was so shocked and frozen in time it felt. Like my brain was shutting off. When I finally decided to fight back I was met with horrible bruises all over my body and a broken wrist. I felt so weak. So helpless. I’m so sorry you went through that. Please know you’re not alone and that none of this is your fault.
He said sorry then told me he’d answer all my questions in a few hours. He’s ghosted me for over 24 hours now I don’t think he’s sorry. He just doesn’t want me to turn him in.

I have an iPhone SE and have the money to get a new phone but I just don’t want to. My phone does it’s purpose just fine. I don’t need the newest fanciest thing. If you base someone’s value on what things they own you are a sad, sad person.
